tasks.short: Deposit guests' valuables in the hotel safe.

steps.what: Check safe-deposit boxes against the guest.
Deposit guests valuables in hotel safes.
Log the deposit after valuables are in the safe.

tasks.design: The hotel desk clerk checks the box with the guest and deposits the valuables. {OPS_SYSTEM} logs that deposit only after it has been made. The log does not place anything in the safe.
tasks.previous_blocker: The deposit was physical, and the same deposit was then written in a safe log.
tasks.enabler_now: The property system can store a deposit line after the clerk has sealed the box.
tasks.still_hard: The guest must be present, the item must be described by a person, and a dispute about contents is not a screen task.
tasks.human_edge: Putting valuables in the safe stays with the clerk, with the guest there.
tasks.altitude: The deposit stays in person. Only the log line after the deposit is shorter.

reach.learn: The box is opened by the desk clerk, not by a log line

evidence.claim: A deposit log can store a box number and a short description after the clerk has made the deposit.
A log of a guest's valuables is personal data, so it records only what the clerk entered after the deposit.

assumptions: The workflow starts when the guest asks to deposit an item and ends when the log is written. Opening the box later stays outside it.
The log fields are box number, a short description the clerk typed, and the clerk's acceptance. The clerk produces them after the deposit. The log is not written first.
The prior treats the task as human. The steps agree on the deposit. Only the later log line is a write.
Upkeep is keeping the list of box numbers.
unknowns: Whether the safe log is still a bound book that must be signed by hand.
What description the property is allowed to store.
research_questions: Must the safe log still be signed by hand?
What may the desk write down about the contents?

already_counted.description: Checking the box with the guest stays inside that step

incremental.description: Keep the list of box numbers

approvals.approved_version: deposit the hotel desk clerk made after checking the box with the guest

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the safe log must stay a signed book, the write is not built and the low end is zero beyond the clerk's unchanged deposit. The deposit itself does not shrink in either case. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Set continental breakfast and coffee supplies.

steps.what: Prepare continental breakfast in the lobby.
Lay out basic food service items.

tasks.design: The hotel desk clerk prepares the continental breakfast and sets the coffee and tea. No system does that work, and nothing is sent in its place.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work is laying out food and drink, so there was no record to connect.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new turns setting a breakfast into a screen task.
tasks.still_hard: Food still has to be set out, kept safe to eat, and cleared by a person.
tasks.human_edge: The clerk still sets the breakfast with their hands.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. Preparing the breakfast and setting the coffee stay as they are.

reach.learn: The breakfast is still set by a person

evidence.claim: Setting out breakfast, coffee, and tea is physical work and stays with a person.

assumptions: The workflow starts when the breakfast is due and ends when it is set. Orders and payments for other meals stay outside it.
No fields are stored. There is no screen step to fall back from.
The prior treats the task as human. The steps agree. None of the time is counted as saved.
Upkeep is zero because no list or screen is added.
unknowns: Whether the desk clerk still sets breakfast at this property.
Whether food safety rules require a named person to sign the setup. That signature would stay human.
research_questions: Does the desk clerk still set the continental breakfast?
Is a signed setup sheet required, and who signs it?

already_counted.description: Preparing the breakfast stays in full inside that step

incremental.description: No screen or list is added, so there is nothing to keep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The conservative case and the centre are the same. Setting the breakfast and the coffee does not shrink, so the saving is zero. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Read the schedule and supervise other employees.

steps.what: Read the schedule another role published.
Supervise other employees on this shift.
Give an employee a task in person.
Note the task the clerk gave that employee.

tasks.design: The hotel desk clerk reads a schedule that another role has already published. The clerk supervises the shift and gives tasks in person. No new roster is built here, and no one is scored.
tasks.previous_blocker: The roster was already published by a manager. The clerk's own work was watching the shift and telling people what to do.
tasks.enabler_now: The published schedule can be opened at the desk. Supervision does not need a second solver.
tasks.still_hard: People arrive late, a break has to change, and the clerk has to see the floor to supervise it.
tasks.human_edge: Supervising employees and giving them a task stay with the clerk. A schedule on a screen is not supervision.
tasks.altitude: Reading the published schedule is a little shorter. Supervising other employees stays the clerk's work, with no score.

reach.learn: The desk clerk reads that schedule and does not publish another one

evidence.claim: A published schedule can be read at the desk without building a second roster.
Watching employees and assigning their work is a decision about people, so no score and no behaviour model is used.

assumptions: The workflow starts when the shift starts and ends when the shift ends. Building or publishing the roster stays with the role that already does it, outside this task.
The clerk reads the published shift. A task note, if written, is the task the clerk gave and the employee name. The clerk writes it. No trait, score, or ranking is stored.
The prior treats the task as human. The steps agree. This task does not add a scheduler.
Upkeep is zero on a solver because none is added. A little time keeps the clerk's own task notes clear of scores.
unknowns: Who publishes the schedule the desk reads.
Whether the property expects the desk clerk to change the roster or only to follow it.
research_questions: Which role publishes the shift schedule today?
May the desk clerk change a published shift, or only supervise within it?

already_counted.description: Reading the published schedule stays partly in that step

incremental.description: Keep task notes free of scores; no roster to maintain here

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the schedule is still on paper, the reading saves nothing and the low end falls to the supervision, which stays in full. No roster is built and no employee is scored in either case. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Arrange tours, taxis, or restaurant reservations.

steps.what: Hear which tours or taxis customers want.
Arrange the tours the customer asked for.
Review the booking record before it is sent.
Send the booking the clerk arranged for customers.

tasks.design: The hotel desk clerk hears what the customer wants, looks up an open slot, and arranges the booking with them. The clerk reviews the filled booking. The send goes out only in that accepted version. Nothing is booked before the customer has asked and the clerk has arranged it.
tasks.previous_blocker: The clerk phoned the restaurant or the taxi desk, then wrote the same details again.
tasks.enabler_now: A slot list and a message can carry the details the clerk has already accepted.
tasks.still_hard: The place may be full, the guest may change their mind, and a taxi time depends on a person answering.
tasks.human_edge: The clerk arranges the booking with the customer. A send is not a new booking.
tasks.altitude: The lookup and the send of an accepted booking are shorter. Hearing the customer and arranging the booking stay with the clerk.

reach.task: Take a booking from the hotel desk
reach.learn: Accept only the version the desk clerk has checked

evidence.claim: A booking message can be sent from the time, place, and name the clerk has already accepted.
Sending a booking the customer did not ask for would commit them, so the clerk arranges it first.

assumptions: The workflow starts when the customer asks and ends when the accepted booking is sent. Payment for the tour, and any change after sending, stay outside it.

The fields are customer name, place, time, party size, and the clerk's acceptance. The clerk produces the acceptance after the customer asks. A missing field stays blank and nothing is sent. The customer can ask by voice; the clerk types the fields.
The prior treats the task as human. The steps agree on hearing and arranging. Only the send of the accepted booking is automatic.
Upkeep is keeping the list of places and the contact for each.
unknowns: Which tours, taxis, and restaurants the desk is allowed to contact.
Whether those contacts accept a message or still require a phone call from the clerk.
research_questions: Which places is the desk allowed to book, and how do they take a booking?
What must the message contain before a restaurant will hold a table?

already_counted.description: Reviewing the filled booking stays partly in that step

incremental.description: Keep the place list and the contact for each place

approvals.approved_version: booking the hotel desk clerk arranged after the customer asked

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the place still requires a phone call, the send is unused and the low end keeps the call inside the arranging, which stays with the clerk. Nothing is sent that the clerk has not reviewed. Provisional, not a measured result.

role.altitude: Deposits, breakfast setup, and supervising the shift stay in person. The clerk reads a schedule someone else published and does not build another one. A tour or a taxi is sent only after the customer asked and the clerk arranged it.
reach: A restaurant or taxi desk receives only the booking the desk clerk has checked
The shift supervisor's published schedule is what the desk clerk reads
skills_to_grow: Logging a deposit only after the valuables are in the safe
Supervising without a score and without a second roster
Sending a booking only in the version the clerk arranged
role.ambitious_version: A deposit is logged after it happens, a shift is supervised without a score, and a booking goes out only because the customer asked and the clerk arranged it.
